tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// las kyi tshogs nyer mkho gces btus dngos grub rin po che'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// khyab bdag rigs gsum sems dpa' la// btud nas las tshogs 'ga' zhig ni// gong ma'i gsung las btu bar bya// de la 'dir las tshogs nyer mkho'i man ngag 'ga' zhig lag tu blang bar 'dod na/ thog mar lho brag mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje'i phyag rdor snyan brgyud las byung ba'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i las tshogs drug ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi la na maḥyi dam gyi lha phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di la/ las tshogs drug gi dang po tshe sgrub kyi las tshogs ni/ dang po sngon 'gro skyabs su 'gro ba 'khrid gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin byas la/ de nas rang yi dam du bsgom pa'i spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng na āḥlas snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga las rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med sku mdog mthing ga mnyam gzhag gi steng na mu men gyi bum pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ lte bar rin po che zur brgyad pa'i steng du swā ser po las rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med sku mdog ser po mnyam gzhag gi steng na gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar hā ljang gu las don yod grub pa tshe dpag med sku mdog ljang gu mnyam gzhag gi steng na in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ kun kyang nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/

gnas lngar yig 'bru lngas mtshan pa rnams kyi rnam snang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po'i mthar/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas bskor bar bsams la/ sngags kyi 'od rtsa nang na mar zhugs pas/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs pa'i tshe nyams par byed pa'i rkyen thams cad phyir thon/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dngos grub dang sa'i bcud bsdus/ rang gi lus la thim par bsams la sngags bzla'o// de nas mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas kyi mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po la/ āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad la sngags bzla/ tshe nyams par byed pa'i rkyen thams cad phyir thon/ bdag gi tshe 'phel bar byed par gsung gi dngos grub thob/ chu'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas rang gi ngag la thim/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe'i 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir thon/ yang bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs dang nam mkha'i bcud bsdus/ rang gi yid la thim/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lte ba'i swā la/ swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe'i 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir thon/ yon tan gyi dngos grub dang*/ me'i bcud bsdus rang gi lte bar thim/ don yod grub pa'i gsang gnas kyi hā la/ hā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ tshe'i 'gal rkyen phyir thon/ phrin las dang rlung gi bcud bsdus/ rang gi gsang gnas su thim par bsam zhing*/ bzlas pa rim pa bzhin bya'o// thun mong du byed na/ dmigs pa dril ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes bzlas bsngo ba bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas tshe 'phel ba'i rtags/

sāts+tsha 'debs pa/ mchod rten la na bza' gsol ba/ mchod rten gyi rtse la 'dug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs mthong ba la sogs byung na/ dus min 'chi ba bzlog ste tshe ring*/ 'di ni tshe sgrub kyi las tshogs so/ ༈ /badz+ra pā ṇi la na maḥ gnyis pa 'pho ba'i las tshogs ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas phyi'i 'chi ltas rim gros bzlog nang gi 'chi ltas dge sbyor gyis bzlog gsang ba'i 'chi ltas byung na 'di ltar nyams su blang*/ rang yi dam mam/ tha mal du gnas pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab bzhir bsam/ de'i dkyil du oṃ las rnam snang*/ mdun du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa'/ g.yas su swā las rin chen 'byung ldan/ rgyab tu āḥlas snang ba mtha' yas/ g.yon du hā las don yod grub pa rnams bsam/ rang gi sems nyid ā dkar po zhig tu bsams la/ a des rigs lnga po de la bskor ba sgo ro ro bsams la/ ngag tu a a a zhes bzla/ rigs lnga'i spyi gtsug nas rang gi spyi gtsug tu rtsa dkar po snang la rang bzhin med pa mda' smyug tsam zhig bsams te/ as rigs lnga la bskor ba byas te/ rtsa'i nang na yar la rim pa bzhin du song ste/ spyi gtsug na yar la thon par bsam/ rlung stod du 'tshangs ba'am/ mgo na ba dang*/ zi thom byung na/ a rnams rtsa nang na mar rim pa bzhin du log ste/ rigs lnga la bskor ba byed pa yin/ de la mi nus na 'phro bcad/ de ni 'pho ba sbyong ba yin no// 'chi nges na 'pho ba 'debs dus su/ rigs lnga la as bskor ba'i rim pa bzhin/ rtsa nang na rim pa bzhin zhugs nas/ spyi gtsug la thon nas dga' ldan du byams pa'i thugs ka'am/ bde ba can du snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka'am rang gang mos pa'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad kyi 'byung ba'i dwangs ma rnams rigs lnga po re re la thim/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu nas rang rang gi sa bon yig 'brur gyur/

de nas oṃ rtsa nang nas yar song*/ spyi bo nas thon lha'i thugs kar thim/ de'i rjes la āḥ de nas hūm̐/ de nas swā/ de nas hā thon par bsam/ dmigs pa a thon bsam dus 'pho ba'i rtags/ 'byung ba stod du 'dus nas/ spyi gtsug la thug bar gyis 'gro/ 'di ni 'pho ba'i gdams pa'o/ ༈ /badz+ra pā ṇi la na maḥ gsum pa khrus kyi gdams pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang rdo rje sems dpar bsam/ bum pa bre gang shong ba yan chad kyi nang du 'bab chu gtsang ma blugs la/ bum rdzas gtsang ma byas la/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ bh+rūm̐ las bum pa phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du bsam/ badz+ra satwa a mṛ ta zhes brjod pas/ bum chu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dkyil du pad+ma'i sdong po zhig bsam/ pad 'dab brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyang*/ 'phags pa mchod/ mthu dang byin rlabs bsdus/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po bskyed rim ji lta bar bsgom/ de'i gnas lngar yig 'bru lnga las rigs lnga bskyed/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar oṃ/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar āḥ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar hūm̐/ rin 'byung gi thugs kar swā/ don grub kyi thugs kar hā/ de dag gi mthar sa bon dang mthun pa'i yi ge brgya pas bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te rang rang la bstim/ de nas rnam snang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po la yi ge brgya pa dkar pos bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad/ yig brgya bzlas pas/ nad gdon zhi bar byed pa bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs te/ bum chu dang dbyer med 'dres par bsam/ ci nus bzlas/ de nas mgrin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas kyi āḥdamar po la yig brgya dmar po/

'dod pa'i phyogs thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i bdud rtsi dmar po/ rdo rje sems dpa'i hūm̐ mthing ga la yig brgya mthing ga yi dam lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi baiḍūr+ya'i mdog rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lte ba'i swā ser po la yig brgya ser po/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i bdud rtsi ser po gser gyi mdog don yod grub pa'i gsang gnas kyi hā ljang gu la yig brgya ljang gu/ phrin las bzhi 'grub pa'i bdud rtsi in+d+ra nī la'i mdog lta bu babs te/ bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la ji nus bzlas la/ de nas bsgrubs nas dbang bskur ba ni/ rang ngam gzhan gyi spyi bor bum pa bzhag dbang bskur ba'i tshig 'di brjod do// chos dbyings ye shes bum pa ru// ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi yis// rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// dug lnga ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ badz+ra satwa āḥ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a a a/ zhes khrus lan lnga byas te/ dug lnga dug gsum thams cad dag par bsam/ 'di ni khrus kyi gdams pa'o/ ༈ /badz+ra pā ṇi la na maḥ bzhi pa sbyin sreg gi gdams pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rdza'i thab khung zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang byed dang mthun pa'i dbyibs/ kun la pad+ma 'dab bzhi mtshon par bya/ de la sdong bu lnga btsugs te phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'o// snum phul phyed tsam blug de nas zhi ba'i rdzas la se ba'i me tog ba lu'i me tog me tog dkar po ci 'dzom du bsag de rnams ma rnyed na ka 'bal lam/ me tog gi gzugs byas la/ de snum la snyug la 'bul ba yin/ mchod pa rnam lnga tshang bar bsham/ til yang bsag go /de nas oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes pas bsang*/ rang yi dam gang yin nam rdo rje sems dpar bsgom/ swa bhā was thab khung stong par sbyang*/

de nas gzhal yas khang du bsam/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lngar rigs lnga'i sa bon re re bsam/ de las 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog dug lnga dug gsum sbyangs/ tshur 'dus sa bon la thim/ 'od du zhu ba las oṃ rnam snang*/ hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa'/ swā rin chen 'byung ldan/ āḥsnang ba mtha' yas/ hā don yod grub pa/ rgyal ba rigs lngar lam gyis bsam/ me sbar ba rnam pa me la ngo bo rigs lngar bsgom/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la rang rang la bstim/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bsgoms pas/ sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku dang sogs/ bla ma'i bstod pa dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' zhes sogs rigs lnga'i bstod pa dang*/ lcang lo can sogs yi dam kyi bstod pa rnams bya/ de nas mchod pa lnga 'bul/ bdun rnam dag bya/ de'i rjes la til la sdig sgrib bstim/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad phul ba'i rjes la/ bstod pa zhi ba'i bzhi bstod la sogs pa rgyas par byas pa'i rjes la/ phyi'i bar du gcod pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig nang gi bar du gcod pa nad gzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= gsang ba'i bar du gcod pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong= sngon gyi las su gyur pa/ 'phral gyi rkyen du gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad zhi bar gyur cig lhag 'byung ba rnams rigs drug la bsngos la/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags brjod/ rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod par bsam/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu mer gyur par bsam/ me cher 'bar bas khams gsum bsregs pa'i rjes la stong par bsgom/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo// rgyas par ram pa dang nas sogs 'bru lnga la sogs pa rang gang 'dod pa'i rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dod yon lnga 'bul/

rang la dngos grub ster bar bsam/ dbang gi me tog dmar po dang*/ spos nas la sogs dbang gi rdzas dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bsdus par bsgom/ drag po la yang de dang 'dra/ 'di ni sbyin sreg gi gdams pa'o/ ༈ /badz+ra pā ṇi na maḥ lnga pa sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ dang po 'bru lnga 'dren zhing sa brkos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'dam bu bcad la/ de la rgyu byin rlabs ni/ 'dam bu'i steng du 'bru lnga bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi dug lnga dug gsum sbyangs/ yang 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ ye shes lnga 'dus/ 'bru lnga la thim/ yang 'od 'phros 'jig rten gyi rat+na rnam lnga'i bcud bsdus shing thim/ 'bru lnga 'od du zhu ba las/ 'dam bu'i rang bzhin rin chen lngar bsgom/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas/ 'jim pa bcad cing 'bru lnga'i sham bu la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nān zhes brjod cing 'bru lnga'i rten tshang bar gzhug oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing 'bi 'bi bya/ 'bru lnga dang badz+ra gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes brjod/ 'bru lnga dang a ra dze'i sngags kyis mar bsku/ 'bru lnga dang*/ badz+ra gar+bhes sku spar du 'jug 'bru lnga dang*/ badz+ra mud ga ra'i sngags kyis gdab/ 'bru lnga dang dharmā dha tu'i sngags kyis 'don/ 'bru lnga dang badz+ra ka ni ka zhes brjod pas chos kyi sku'i mchod rten du bsams la bzhugs/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas 'khor ba ma stongs bar la bzhugs par bsam/ des gral 'grig par bzhugs/ cha gsum dang mchod pa lnga bshams la rab gnas byed pa spyi dang mthun/ nas kyi me tog la shākya thub pa dang rigs lnga bsgom zhing*/ rten 'brel snying po mang du bzlas shing*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// thugs rje can rnams dgongs su gsol// de ring rten la rab gnas bgyi// gzigs shing byin gyis brlab du gsol// zhes brjod cing me tog longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sprul pa'i sku la thim par bsam/

me tog gtor bas chos kyi sku dang gnyis su med pa'i sku ru bsgom/ 'bru lngas sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab/ bkra shis brjod/ bdun rnam dag gis mchod pa gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma rnams btang la/ rjes bsngo ba bya'o// 'di ni sāts+tsha'i gdams pa'o/ ༈ /badz+ra pā ṇi la na maḥ drug pa gtor ma'i las tshogs ni/ gtor ma gcig la brten nas brgya tsam stong tsam byed kyang byin rlabs kyang 'bru lngas byed/ 'bul kyang 'bru lngas 'bul/ da res kyi skabs 'dir spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dgug gzhug mi dgos/ rang gar 'dug chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/ gzugs thams cad mi snang dmigs med chos kyi sku/ rdzas thams cad 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi mchod yon tu rtogs pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i rang bzhin gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ āḥzhes brjod pas ro phun sum tshogs pa/ hūm̐ gis dri phun sum tshogs pa/ swā zhes pas reg bya phun sum tshogs par gyur/ hā zhes brjod pas sgra phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron/ 'byung po lan chags kyi mgron/ yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la bsngo'o// rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /yul lha gang mos thob gyur cig /bu lon lan chags byang gyur cig /pha ma la sogs 'gro drug la// tshad med gtor ma 'di phul bas// longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs rdzogs nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /de lta bas thag bcad nas bsngos pas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par gyur cig snang la rang bzhin med par bsngos pas/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par gyur cig ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur te bsngos pas/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par gyur cig sku gsum mngon du gyur te 'gro ba sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'grub par gyur cig

de rnams ni gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i las tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can la phan 'dogs pa yi dam kyi lhas gsungs pa bzhin/ bdag las kyi rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ bkra shis/ ༈ /lho brag phyag na rdo rjes rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po la gnang ba shin tu zab pa'i jag chings ni/ rang gar 'gro ba'i lam der zhugs te/ rang nyid dam pa sangs rgyas su bsgoms la g.yas nas rde'u bcu gsum blangs te/ de la/ oṃ su pra ti nan swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags mang du bzlas nas btab ste rang gi gdong la gtor/ de rnams lcags kyi mi rings bcu gsum du gyur nas rang la gnod byed kyi tshogs thams cad bcom par bsam/ dmigs pa de rnams bsgoms nas phyin na jag pa byung dogs med ces shin tu zab pa'i man ngag // ༈ /yang gcig la/ rang gi spyi bor rje btsun ma sgrol ma sngon mo phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon me tog snyan drung du kha phye ba bsnams pa gcig bsgom/ rdzas ni rang gar 'gro ba'i g.yas nas rde'u nag po dgu blangs te/ rde'u re re la sngags nyer gcig re btab/ rang gi thu ba g.yas su btums/ mdud pa la sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re bhan+dha ku ru swā hā/ rang gang 'dod pa phyin pa dang*/ rde'u rnams lag pa g.yas pas blangs nas sngar blangs pa'i sar 'thor ro/ ༈ /shwa zlog ni/ ldong ros dang la chu gnyis bsres pas g.yam pa sngon po la 'di bzhin bris te shwa yong ba'i gdong la bltas nas bzhag g.yam pa'i sgrom bu chus mi khyer bar sba'o// shwa srung ba'i man ngag mang yang re mig ma 'di shwa bo bas shwa khang brgya bzlog pas dge bshes shwa bo sgang bar grags/ zab pa'i tshad/ bab las bris kyang rung zab/ ༈ /char 'bebs par 'dod na/ bag phye la dkar gsum mngar gsum dang klu sman sna tshogs btab pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas la sngags/ nā ga ka la ka la bha ri sha ya swā hā/

zhes ril bu la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la btab/ klu yod pa'i chu mig khar blugs na char 'bab par nges so/ ༈ /char pa srung ba'i man ngag la/ sre mong sha/ sbal pa'i sha/ te lo'i sha/ sbrul sha/ nya sha rnams bsres la dud pa btang*/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo bsgom/ char pa gang byung la sdigs mdzub bya/ sdigs mdzub rtse las rlung byung*/ sprin dang char pa thams cad gtor bar bsams la/ sad ka ra phaṭa phaṭa go ra la d+ya ma hi tsakra sbas shig char chod ces bzlas so// rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /yang gcig la kha char gcod na/ ka lu ka me lu ka la ka me lu/ s+t+waṃ bha ya sho la pa ra ram kru sha bar shan tsa lu bi swā hā/ shog ldeb 'di'i nang du sngags kyi khram ris 'dug pas dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ ? zhes bzlas nas phus btab mdzub ris bya'o zab/ ༈ /ser ba bsrung ba la/ ga ru ḍa haṃ tsa le tsa le swā hā/ sad phur sad pra mun tri sad/ ces bzlas nas nam mkha' la phu gdab bo/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal la gnas nas// ka ra ka ra se ra ti sa ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa mang du bgrangs nas nam mkhar phus btab pas chod nges so/ ༈ /yang sad bsrung bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ nā ga sha sha shu shu ma li swā hā/ zhes dkar gsum/ mngar gsum la bzlas/ klu yod pa'i chu mig tu blugs na sprin 'du nges shing sad bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /btsa'i sngags ni/ me khu chu pho bu shel ka'i nan sum baṃ baṃ baṃ ri na sad dho yal/ ces bye ma la bzlas nas zhogs kyi res gtor/ des thub nges so/ ༈ /zhing la 'bu bsrung na/ srin gyi sbal po sod/ srid bu rā tsa sod/ srin snying sod/ dar dur drangs pa sod/ ces pa bzlas bye ma la btab nas gtor na thub nges so/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ oṃ kha kha kha ga ri mo mo ri rdza rdza rdza ri swā hā/ thal chen dang rdza thal bsres pa la sum stong bzlas na zhing gi mtha' bskor zhing zhing gseb tu gtor na ri bong sha ba byi ba 'bu srin rnams thub nges so gsung zab/

༈ /yang rin po che bstan bzang nas brgyud pa'i re ma ti'i rims srung ni/ hā pha ra ma ta ṭa go mak+ṣa ta sa oṃ/ mjug nas bsgril 'dogs thag dkar po snal ma nag pos dkris/ mgul tu btags pas thub/ ༈ /yang*/ btsod mdud/ tshos chen/ rta khrag gsum shig re tsam mnyes pa la sngags 'di bzhin brgya bzlas nas btab/ dar dmar po'am/ ras dmar po la ril ma tsam gyi thum bu byas la/ rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas gong ba g.yas la btags na shol rims lo gcig thub gsungs/ gong gi sngags ni/ 'brum shal shal dug chod rgyu gzer la swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ /thab shor na/ oṃ sa khyim na hūm̐ ko na swā hā/ zhes phye la bzlas nas thab khung du blugs na thab bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /ya ma'i srung ba ni/ rtsa ya ma sod/ khrag ya ma sod/ chu ser ya ma sod/ srin ya ma sod/ gnyan ya ma sod/ rlung ya ma sod/ dmar smug 'khyil ba sod/ ces bzlas pa btab/ oṃ byi li byi li sod mi li byi li sod/ ya ma nag po sod/ srin gyi grong khyer la sngags 'di thun phob/ ya ma rak+ṣa swā hā/ 'chang ba la ya ma'i nad thams cad bsrung du gsol rak+ṣa/ srung ba zab/ ༈ /mig gi nad gso thabs ni/ btsan gnod na dmar rtsa gcig 'ong*/ klu srin gnod na sngo srib 'ong*/ thab gzhob yin na rmug 'dzin 'ong*/ nad la gnod pa yod na bcos dgos/ de nas sngags btab ste/ mig ngos la nyi shu rtsa gcig btab/ ltag pa nas brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ sngags ni/ oṃ ig shad/ 'di shin tu rno bas gsang*/ mang na mig chu 'dzag ༈ /mig la gra ma shor ba 'don pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ la ma ling la ma da na ting la swā hā/ zhes pa bzlas nas sna nas phus 'debs so/ ༈ /yang mig phyid pa la/ oṃ sbu he swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas nas phus te 'gro'o/ ༈ /mig du ba dang kha bas phyid pa la/ spang rgyan gyi khu ba ras la btsags pa mig la byugs pas phan/ ༈ /so'i nad gso thabs ni/ so srin 'bu srungs shig tsi ri ni ri nan rbad/

ces sngags 'di shog gu la dbu can bris/ gla rtsi gu gul gnyis byugs gsham nas dril/ skud pa dmar pos dkris lung thag bya/ srung ba zab/ ༈ /so srin 'don pa'i gdams pa la/ oṃ 'khyug rtsa dur rbad swā hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig sogs bzlas pa smyug ma'am sog ma'i sbubs nas so rtsa la blan nas brdegs par bya'o// / ༈ /yang sna khrag gcod pa la/ theb theb khreb khreb chod chod/ lan bdun gyis chog mang na khong khrag skem nyen yong zab/ ༈ /rta'i spu bsregs pa'i thal ba rma la btab na chod nges so// yang bud med bu skyes nas khrag ma chod na 'om bu'i dud pas 'doms nas bdug skud pa phra mos nywa bzhi bkyigs/ des phan no/ ༈ /mngal khrag gcod pa la/ tha na du ru ri swā hā/ zhes lug gi klad pa la mang du btab nas lto stong du btang skyes khrag chod/ ༈ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ubs ubs suṃ suṃ/ sarba nan rbad swā hā/ hūm̐ phaṭa na ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rma kha la mchil ma byugs na rdo rje dang mtshon gyi rma dang rtsa chad pa dang*/ klad pa chad pa rnams sos par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /khyis rmugs pa'i rma che chung gang yin kyang*/ oṃ nan khyi nan sod/ khrag chod/ rnag skam/ dbal zhi/ zhes pa ci mang bzlas la rma dkris mi byed pa lag len yin/ ༈ /yang khyis rmugs pa'i rma gso ba'i thabs la/ dang po rang chus bkrus/ mu le ni khyi nad sod/ ces mis ma tshor ba byas nas ci mang bgrangs rma la btab/ khyi spu dang ra'i spu bsres la bkab/ de gnyis po'i skud pa zhun mas bsdams zhes pa na nges so/ ༈ /yang rgyal mo'i steng du ling thog 'byung ba sel na/ rang nyid skad cig gis phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba gcig bsgoms nas/ gya phur swā hā/

zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas gro sog la skud pa dkar nag gnyis dkris mig gi thad btsug gro sog gi sbubs gnyis kyi nang nas mar la sbrul dkar nag gnyis thon te ling thog lhag ma ma lus par lces bldags nas slar log nas zhal gyi sgor thim par bsam/ de yang yang byas pas phan nges so/ ༈ /dpal don grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir skyes bu lus sbyor gyi gdams pa la/ mchod rten la bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa mang yang*/ 'dir lha las babs pa'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba ya yo dang khyag khyogs med pa bzang ba gcig bris/ de'i bum pa'i dbus su khye'u byad bzhin bzang ba rgyan cha lugs kyis brgyan pa pho mtshan can gcig bris/ de'i mtha' skor du gzungs 'di yi ge mgo phyir bstan pa gcig bris/ de'i mtha' skor du ye dharmā yig mgo phyir bstan pa gcig bris/ rab gnas rgyas par bya/ mgo mjug ma log par btags la bzung*/ tshon skud sna lngas bcings/ skog snam bu gsar pas g.yogs/ rab gnas grub nas sa la mi 'jog mi gzhan gyis lag mi brgyud/ srung ba 'dogs pa'i tshe dus bzang po tshes bco lnga la btags la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa gzung du gzhug mchod rten la sku dkar dang dar lcog gzhan yang zhal zas mar me la sogs pa ci 'byor pa 'bul du gzhug go /de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams thar pa sangs rgyas kyis sar bsngo/ gnas skabs su yid mthun pa'i khye'u 'byung ba'i ched du bsngos/ khye'u de yang lag pa g.yas zhal zas thogs pa/ g.yon pas snang gsal thogs pa gcig bri/ gong gi gzungs ni/ oṃ ma ma te ti hūm̐ dhi na te ti hūm̐/ ma ma bskyed bskyed hūm̐/ bdag 'chang ba mo 'di zhes bgyi ba la yid kyi bu khye'u bskyed du gsol/ zhes mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang gi sngags so// de'i tshe khrus legs par byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ rgyan dang cha lugs legs par bzhugs so// de bzhin byas pas bu bskyed cing dga' bar 'gyur la/

bde ba thob pas skyid par 'ong*/ bu 'phel bar gyur cig ci byas bu ru gyur cig bu skyes tshe bla ma la na bza' bzang ba cha tshang re dang*/ zla ba re'i gsol phog bzang ba re 'bul dgos pas bka' rgya yod do/ ༈ /lcags kyi s+t+wa gri che chung gang yin kyang rung*/ yu ba shing stag pas byas/ sngags ni/ oṃ maṃ li ma ma skyed de de hūm̐/ zhes pa gro ga'am shog gu la bris te yu ba la dkris te kra shad kyis bcings so mo ngos la bstan/ mos ma tshor bar byas mal du sba'o// yid ches pa'i bya ba ni bya tshang 'og tu bcug pas phru gu pho dag skye'o/ ༈ /sri'u gso ba la/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso bar 'dod na/ thabs 'di ltar bya ste/ tshe rta dang tshe thag gi sgo nas bsrung ba dang*/ mda' dang gtor ma'i sgo nas bsrung ba'o// dang po tshe rta'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa'am sor bcu gnyis pa gcig rgya mdud ma la hūm̐ gcig bris te/ chos skyong mgon por bskyed la ye shes pa gzhug gtor ma phul te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ byis pa 'di la srungs shig ces bya ba brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa byis pa 'di la srungs shig swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas te/ de yang mgon po'i zhal nas bdag gi zhal du/ bdag gi thugs ka nas mgon po'i thugs kar 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla bar bya'o// de nas phrin las bcol te ka ba la sogs pa la btags nas bzhag go /tshe thag gi sgo nas bsrung ba ni skud pa sngon po gsum sgril gcig la mdud pa re la sngags nyi shu rtsa re btab/ mdud pa lnga'am bdun byas la btags/ byis pa de mgon po lngas bskor nas bsrung bar bsam mo// mda'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni/ mda' bya rgod kyi gsum sgro ma me ma shor ba gcig la dar nag po kha gang btag tsar dang stod nag pos byas pa sgro'i bar la/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ byis pa 'di la srung shig swā hā/ zhes pa gsum sgro'i bar du bris/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas gang rung re res chog gsung ngo*// de nas mda' de dpal mgon por bskyed rten du gzugs so// khyed la rten du 'cha' bas byis pa 'di la 'tshe ba thams cad las srung shig lo dus su khyod la gtang rag chen po gtong gi byas la mis ma 'gom pa'i sar rten du gzung bar bya'o// gtor ma'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni zhal las shes so// sri'u gso ba'i man ngag*/ ༈ /zho chang bsrung ba ni/ rdo leb gcig la/ oṃ sha ba ri sha ba ri swā hā/ zhes bris nas de'i steng du bzhag pas phan no// oṃ nyag nyag sod/ nyag nyag na/ oṃ ti tha ti tha/ oṃ lo ka lo ka baṃ baṃ thuṃ thuṃ khraṃ khraṃ mug mug swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas nas btab/ phab nas pam̐ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi ljang gur bsam/ rang yi dam gang byed kyi snying po bzlas te btab/ ye dharmās rab gnas byas pas thub bo/ ༈ /zho chang phyugs sogs la gnod pa byung na/ oṃ tha ra ti tha ra ti ma hā tha ra ti ni gnod byed 'byung po thams cad kha chings/ zhes mang du bzlas nas btab pa'i bsrung skud sgo'i ya them glum phad kyi kha zho zo'i lung rnams la btags pas thub bo/ ༈ /'khru ba dang skyugs pa gcod par 'dod na/ mi pho la ra pho'i spu/ mo la ra mo'i spu/ 'khru na phyir la 'gro dus/ skyugs na nang la yong dus kyi spu la skud pa phyi sgril gsum byas la mdud pa gsum gdab/ oṃ bruṃ bruṃ blaṃ blaṃ shal shal swā hā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas nas btab/ 'khru na sked pa/ skyugs na skye la 'dogs chod nges so zab/ ༈ /glang thabs gsod pa la sngags kyis bcos pa ni/ srin gyi bal po pha sod/ srin gyi bal mo ma sod/ srin bu rā dza sod/ rā dza dro mo mal du chod/ ces pa tshwa snying la mang du bzlas la khong du btang*/

rang nyid srin kyis na na bsnyen pa bya/ des ma phan na dge slong gtsang ma'am/ khye'u gtsang ba'i bar chu la sngags mkhan rang gi lag pa bkrus pa'i khu ba la sngags mang du btab nas nad pa la gsang ste byin ma skyug par byed/ des srin dang*/ ma zhu mkhris pa/ bad kan rnams la shin tu phan zab/ yang glang thabs gang gis kyang mi phan na/ spang spos rtsa ba zhib btags thun gcig chang gar mas phul nas btang na shin tu phan no/ ༈ /mes tshig pa la/ oṃ me ri dmar po sod/ chu ri sngon po sod/ lcags ri nag po sod/ zhi zhi graṃ graṃ swā hā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas nas btab na/ lus thams cad tshig pa yang sos par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /me dbal gsod pa'i sngags ni/ nag po ta pa sod/ ta pa nag po sod/ ces mang du bzlas zab/ mes tshig pa la/ shing a wa ma ra kha/ zhes ci mang bzlas/ dug thar nu ra snum khol ma la btab nas bskus nas nyi ma la bsregs na shin tu phan/ ༈ /yang mes tshig pa la/ tshos shing*/ sug pa/ chu rtsa/ bul tog bsres nas bskus na shin tu phan no/ ༈ /shu ba gso ba la/ oṃ ni la badz+ra u pa ta badz+ra ste badz+ra swā hā/ zhes pa nyungs kar dang yug pa bsres pa'i thal ba mar nag la btab/ lus kyi shu ba gang yod la srin lag gis byugs te nyi ma la bsregs pas phan zab/ ༈ /yang ngo shig byung na/ zhu mkhan/ yung ba/ sga skya rnams kyi phye ma zhib mo chu la sbyar nas byugs pa sel lo/ ༈ /'dzer pa khrus byas dge slong rnam dag gi chos gos kyis yang yang phyis/ ku ru ra swā hā/ zhes pa mang du btab/ chu bskor phye g.yab kyis yang yang phyi'o/ ༈ mi phyugs sogs kyi rtsa chu 'gag pa la/ mar la/ hu chu hu chu/ rngub chu rngub chu/ du ba du ba/ chu chil me ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas rtsa sgo dang chu sgor byugs na thon par 'gyur ro// 'di la the tshom ma byed zab/ dri chen dri chu 'gag pa la/ sngags stong tsho gcig bzlas la blud des nges par grol lo// sngags ni/

oṃ snyan snyan hri de ba hri ka la ma la de la swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ /mi dang rta bong gi bu shor long yod pa la/ kra sa ma sgo khog ka kyi ma sgo khog 'byung ba 'dus ma'i sgo khog ces pa yi ge dbu can gzab bris la rab gnas byas mi'i mthu sne dang*/ rta bong gi mjug ma la btags des thub/ zab/ ༈ /mi dang phyugs kyi bu ro ma thon pa la/ ri bong gi ril ma bdun chu dron mo la sbyar nas khong du btang na nad las grol lo/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ sngags rigs bzhi bsdus la/ ta le phyung*/ zhes pa g.yas la btags na le shig ces pa g.yon la btags/ su ra ka ra phyug ces pa spyi gtsug tu btags/ rting pa a ma shag shag ces pa rkang gcig la gdags so// rgya gar ma ti paṇa chen nas rim gyis brgyud do// bu btsas ma thag srung ba ma bkrol na bu snod lug yong bas skyes 'phral du 'grol ba gal che'o/ ༈ /khyi smyon bcos pa'i thabs la/ rngul 'don byed nas oṃ ti ti phyi phyi swā hā/ zhes dpral ba'am snying gar btab/ oṃ taṃ pa le thuṃ pa le ma he ma he hri hri swā hā/ zhes gom pa nyer gcig dbugs bsdams nas me long la ha btab pa'am ldag pa gang rung byed/ khyi gzugs 'dug na yod pa yin/ dmar ham 'dug na yod pa yin/ du ris 'dug na yod pa yin/ nag ham 'dug na yod pa yin/ khrag gi dmar leb byung na bad kan dang nor ba shas che bas ma nor ba gal che/ mi nub khyi smyon bcos pa'i thabs/ lug dkar sogs bal g.yas pa la mdud pa bdun brgyabs/ dkyil du dom lpags zur gsum bcug mdud pa re la sngags 'di nyer gcig re btab/ sngags ni/ oṃ gzugs med mkha' 'gro yi dam lha'i snying po la swā hā/ zhes pa'o// 'di ni phyi'i srung ba yin/ nang gi srung ba 'di lta ste/ dkyil du gtor ma zur gsum gcig mtheb kyu nyi shu rtsa gcig la re re la sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla/ oṃ ag chu khye lto swā hā/ zhes pa'o// khong du btang ngo*// nang gi sngags 'di ni mi phyugs gang la yang ltag par 'debs/

me long g.ya' med pa la btang*/ 'di bas lhag pa'i bcos thabs gzhan na med/ rgya bod gang la yang med zab/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ oṃ ku ku rā dza kha thaṃ/ ku ku rā dza nad zhi/ sa le su la spu shag na le tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ zhes pa zan la sngags te/ sgo khyi la byin na mi smyo sgo khyi srung ba'o/ ༈ /khyi ra ba kha chings ni/ rang pha dam par bsgom/ ri dwags khyis ded byung na/ ri dwags seng ge 'phyo ba bzhin brag la tshur rang ngos la mchongs par bsam/ rang dam par bsgom pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis khyi phar phul bar bsgom/ sngags bzlas/ oṃ thar ni thar ni ma hā thar ni swā hā/ zhes pa'o// gal te ri dwags mig gis mthong bar khyi ra ba chas 'gro bar mthong na mi khyi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rde'u g.yag ru'i nang du bcug kha re bas btums/ 'bru mar la gong gi sngags bzlas 'debs/ de ltar byas na shin tu zab/ ༈ /spyang ki kha chings la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ ya me ya me swā hā/ zhes pa spyang ki'i 'jigs pa byung na sa la btab la gtor/ ༈ /gnyan bsrung ba la/ gnyan la phan pa'i za yig 'di'i bri lugs la tshag med phreng gcig rdzogs par byed gla rtsi'i chu byugs la btang bas phan/ gag gag snyan snyan gyur gyur bsdus bsdus bsrub bsrubaḥ ces bris nas zhabs nas dril bar bya'o// yang lhog rgod kyis zin na phyugs la bcos lang med par phal cher 'chi ba yin/ rtags su sna dang mig nas rnag 'dra byung na 'chi ba yin pas/ nag po rbad na ya rbad ma haṃ rbad thum hril rbad/ zhag gsum gyi bar sbas la/ de nas bsha' 'o// phyugs 'tsho'i sna ru dud pa btang*/ 'phangs su me sbar/ rnga ma'i rtse nas sngags kyis 'bud/ sna'i 'og tu zangs gzhong bzhag rtags ci yin gcig byung nas bsha' bar bya'o// de yang sha zangs chus bkang ba la kha bstan nas sngags 'di btab bo// oṃ me dad gho ma sod/ oṃ me dad gho ma sod/ oṃ mo snyan mo sod/ lhog de dhe ba sod/ mo dhe ba dbal sod/

dbal rdo rngam sod/ tsam de sod/ ya ma du du swā hā/ zhes rgya gar ngan sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas gdab po// oṃ phra phra ma ma rang rang du du kaṃ kaṃ kum kum klag len swā hā/ zhes pa bram ze'i sngags so// oṃ dur dur nyar nyer can zlog rngos po med swā hā/ spyang mo'i sngags so// oṃ krug me hi kring kring swā hā/ pho rog gi sngags so// sngags tshan bzhi po 'di'i sngags chu khong du gtong khong srung yin/ phyir skrad pa la btab na rnag khrag 'joms par byed/ sngags sha la btab ste zos na nyes pa mi 'byung*/ phyugs nad gso ba'i gdams pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// snyigs ma'i dus na 'di rnams rin po che// kun la yod na mkhas pa su yis byed// mkhas pa'i khyad 'don sngags dang sman du bsdebs// sems can don du lag len khrigs su bsdebs par mdzad pa 'di ni ri dbon zhig po nga la yod/ de sras phur pa rgyal mtshan sogs la brgyad zab/ ༈ /'brum pa srung ba la/ oṃ badz+ra la tha ra sa du yi 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa bris lag ngar la btags/ yang na sran ma bdun la re re la sngags brgya brgya btab nas mgul du gdags so// dge bshes bya yul pa'i man ngag zab/ ༈ /shig srung ba'i thabs la/ oṃ tsa tri sod/ ces ba ra mar la 'bum tsho gcig bzlas nas lus la byugs na thub nges so/ ༈ /khyi shig bsrung ba la/ ldong ros/ byi thang ka mu zi/ yungs kar bzhi chu la sbyar nas lce la bskus na khyi shig mi yong zab/ ༈ /'brum pas gre ba 'gags na/ sngags 'di stong rtsa gcig sman 'thung rgyu la btab nas btung*/ a pa ta sha na he/ zhes so// 'brum nad gso ba la/ shog bu la gu gul gyi snag tshas/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ dza ra ba du ye bdag la srungs shig swā hā/ zhes pa bris la sngags 'di brgya rtsa dang ye dharmā brgya rtsas me tog la sngags te rab gnas byas te lag ma brgyud pa rang gzhan gyi rke la btags na thub/

las de stan thog gcig tu bya zhes na bza' bas bsrung zab/ ༈ /kha nad gso ba la/ skyer pa'i bar shun/ yung ba/ hong len/ seng phrom/ ru rta rnams mar dkar la sbyar ba bsku'o/ ༈ /yang gre ba 'gag na/ na le sham/ pi pi ling*/ rgya skyegs rnams cha mnyam chu dron la blugs btang na phan no/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ gre ba 'gag nas 'phral du na ba la/ a ru ra 'o ma sbang ba la/ oṃ ma nu ma nu tring to la swā hā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas la btab/ a ru ra'i khu ba gre bar btang ngo*/ ༈ /yang lce dang lkog ma na ba la/ rma yod med gang yin kyang*/ sbal sha skam po zho dang sbyar ba lce thog tu yun ring bskyil nas/ mchil ma phyir dor bas phan no/ ༈ /rna ba'i nad sel ba la/ rna ba la yang khrag 'on/ rlung 'on/ rtsa 'gram gang yin kyang*/ rgya tshwa nas tsam gcig ru rta nas tsam gnyis/ la phug nas tsam gsum/ de rnams zhib par btags pa la/ mar nag lo lon lcags thur gyi nang du 'jam tsam bsros pa thig pa gcig la sman sran ma tsam gcig sbyar la sman ldugs pa'i gong du gu gul gyi dud pa bdug rim gro la gtor ma brgya rtsar btang*/ sman blugs la rna ba zan dron gyis bkag la bzhag go /nangs par snga dro nyi ma'i zer dang sprad la nad dang sman rtsi/ 'jab rtse la sogs pas dal bus brus la yang du song ma song blta ba yin/ rna bas don byed nus pa'i bar la sman blug go /sman blug pa'i bar la rnga mi brdung*/ dung mi 'bud/ yos mi 'thag rus mi 'cha'/ 'deg pa'i las mi byed/ khur bu mi khur/ 'di rnams dam tshig go /rna ba'i nang za ba dang*/ drod che ba dang*/ sgra 'ur pa rnams byung na phan pa myong bas grub zab/ ༈ /skyes pa'i rlig pa skrangs pa la/ su ru su ru ma hā ku ru li ya phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa 'di bud med kyi chu ngan la bzlas la byugs/ ༈ /bud med kyi nu ma skrangs pa la/ su ma lta ra ma 'jid da ra na swā hā/ zhes pa phag tshil lam lo mar la btab nas byug go

༈ /gze bsrung ba la/ sngags 'di rdo mar ram mthe bong la brgyabs nas blan no// sngags ni/ me'i dbal so zhi/ zhes so// yang gcig la/ oṃ gi tsam bam por gar dze stis stis swā hā/ zhes pa 'di chu nang gi rdo la btab nas brlan/ chu la btab nas 'thung du gzhug na/ 'dre gzer/ rlung gzer/ khrag gzer gang yin kyang thub bo/ ༈ /yang gnyid chung ba'i thabs la/ spang rgyan dkar po/ lce tsha dkar po/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma dang gsum sbyar nas du ba sna bug tu btang na gnyid chung*/ ༈ /yang gcig la/ lug gi mig skam du bcug la zhib par btags te dpral bar bskus na gnyid chung zab/ ༈ /sha dug bsrung ba'i thabs la/ oṃ ku ru ru swā hā/ zhes pa mang du bgrang nas sha la brgyabs nas zos pa sha dug gi 'jigs pa las grol lo/ ༈ /sman gyi bla ma la na mo/ sha dug gso ba'i man ngag la/ sha la rkyen bzhis dug tu 'gyur// sa rlabs srid dang nyi zhur dang*// skyur la dug tu song ba'i rigs// gang yin brtags la shes par bya// de yang*/ gre ba 'gags shing pho ba sbo// mig gis mi mthong skyur gyi dug /pho ba glang thabs dag tu na// sa yi dug tu shes par bya// dri ma dang ni dri chu sdom// srid pa'i dug tu shes par bya// gso ba'i man ngag gdams pa ni// rgya gar dag gi skad du ni// sngo ni dkar po chig thub ste// bod kyi skad du spre'u sman// spre'u sman ni sgong thog pa// de yi khrod du ka ra btab// dug 'joms sman gyi mchog tu bshad// gre ba 'gag la dkar po bzhi// btang bas gre ba'i nad rnams zhi// dri chu dri ma 'gags par yang*// ru gsum sga tig lcam pa'o// ug chos dmar po dag kyang btang*// dpyid dang tshigs la 'gram pa na// so ma rā tsa sbrang rtsi dang*// gser gyi bar shun btang ste sdud// 'gram na sdud pa'i sman mchog yin// pho ba mi bzod na na yang*// grib skyes ba lu btang bas chog /dkar dang skyur gyi rnam pa spang*// glo ba dag la bab pa na// gur gum brag zhun btang bas chog

/spre'u snying po'i sngo sman sha dug gso ba shin tu zab pa'i man ngag*/ ༈ /yang sbyar dug srung ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ trig le hri hūm̐/ zhes lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga la sngags thebs lnga/ srin lag gi tshigs bu la lan bdun btab la 'jib/ des dug rigs thams cad thub nges so/ ༈ /yang btsan dug sha dug sbyar dug sogs dug rigs thams cad la sngags gcig pu 'di bzlas chu la btab nas khong du btang bas dngos su phan pa myong bas 'grub bo/ ༈ /lba ba'i rmen bcad gdams pa ni// gnam stong tho rangs skar ma ni// ma gyes dus su ol gong cig /thems par bzhag nas rkang pas mnan// lag g.yas skam pa 'phyar byas la// g.yon pas phreng ba rtsa gcig gzung*// sngags bzlas ol gong pa la btab// skam pas them par brdungs la za// zho brod tsam yang lan cig gis// med 'gyur thang gsum smros ci dgos// oṃ bhur khung ma sa ra kha gats+tsha bhi ma na se hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'o// zab*/ ༈ /skran la/ na sa ta sa sha ta na ma sha ta sa sha/ zhes mang du bzlas tshwa la btab nas zos pas shin tu phan no/ ༈ /rta drel bong gsum gyi chams pa bsrung ba la/ gu gul/ sha chen/ bya rgod kyi sha/ gna' ba'i rwa'i rtse/ stag sha ba lnga po cha mnyam du btags/ du bas bdugs pas zla ba re'i chams pa thub par nges/ lo re'i khong du du bas bdugs pas yong mi srid/ chams pa byung ba la du bas yang yang bdugs pas gnyan sod nas 'tsho ba thag chod/ chams pa byung na sman gyi sman bongs chen sman nad kyis 'chi bas thun chung dgos zab/ ༈ /rngo'i rigs gang byung yang*/ mu zi/ phag tshil/ thar nu/ g.yer ma/ du ba/ bul tog rnams bsdus la gro tshan gyis byugs brul/ tsha ba che na chu tshan gyis bkru/ ༈ /gag pa gso ba la/ rang gi mgrin par me'i bya khyung chung ngu cig bsgom/ de las bya khyung grangs med pa me stag lta bur 'phros/ mgrin pa nas btsas lus thams cad gang bar bsgom/ hri hri shag shag tsheg tsheg thol thol rbad rbad sod sod/

ces pa chu la bzlas nas gag pa byung ba gzhan la byin na phan gsungs/ sngags 'di blo la yod pas gag pa mi yong gsung zab/ ༈ /lhogs rim bsrung ba la/ rang yi dam gang yin du bsgom/ nan nan sod sod/ 'dul 'dul/ phub phub/ chom chom/ kro ta sod/ ces bgrangs pas thub/ gzer dang shu ba lhog rims kun la sngags brgyabs pas phan/ sngags bgrangs pas rgyu ma khrol yong*/ de rgyag ran pa'i tshod yin/ rgyu ma khrol nas bgrang na rang la 'khru ba yong zab/ ༈ /lug nad gcod pa'i sngags ni/ tsa su la tsa rbad ces bye ma dul ma la brgyabs nas gtor zab/ ༈ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dug gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su ri rab nag po gru bzhi pa'i steng*/ rang nyid khyung nag po gshog pa dang mchu sder lcags las byas pa gser mig 'khyil ba dung gi 'che ba can gyi phyag gnyis gdug pa can zhal du 'dren pa/ sku las sprul pa'i khyung nag po phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas me stag 'phro ba gcig tu gyur par bsgoms la/ oṃ nag po kā la rak+ṣa rbad rbad sod sod phyung phyung*/ spu gri zangs zings lcags kyi sder mos snying phyung*/ gnod byed gdug pa'i sha la zo/ oṃ lhang lhang tser/ 'ub 'ub/ sod sod/ ces pa bzlas la 'debs pa'i tshe/ kha nas me stag 'phros pas nad thams cad tshig par bsgom/ mjug tu phus btab pas thal ba yang mi dmigs par bsam mo// rtsub drag na/ oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung thum thum rbad rbad swā hā/ zhes bzlas na 'joms pa yin/ des ni thab shu ba 'bras gag pa lhog pa gzer klu gnyan sa bdag srin po rgyal 'gong gnod pa sogs la sngags 'dis sel/ srung skud nag po mdud pa bdun la sngags btab rab gnas byas nas 'dogs/ sngas srung byed na nad pa'i gnas gsum la sngags 'debs zab/ ༈ /byis pa kha tshe ngu ba la/

byin rlabs can dge slong gi gsol chen/ sgog skya bsregs pa dang mar dkar dang gcig tu bsnos la rten 'brel snying po bzlas grib so 'ub 'dus pa la bu chung la nag zhur bya'o zab/ ༈ /yang sāts+tsha ser po bzhi byas nas rgya mthong kyi zur bzhir bzhag na thog thub nges so zab/ ༈ /yang khyu mchog sngon po gcig gi khog par sngags 'di bris/ oṃ tsa na dha ma hā badz+ra kro dha ya hu lu hu lu a pa ra tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na dur la ha ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ye shes pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gsum spyan drangs nas bstims/ rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas gang 'gro sar bcangs na tshe ring nad med mnga' thang che phyug por 'gyur ro// khyu mchog la brten nas bsod nam tshogs spel ba'o/ ༈ /dbang sdud ni/ rang phyag na rdo rje gzi mdangs che ba gcig tu bsgom/ khrom pa kun gsol ba 'debs shing rang phyogs byed par bsam/ pha rol de las bzlog par bsam/ rkang pa g.yon ngos nas sa tshom gcig blangs nas sngags btab la khrom la gtor ro// sngags ni/ oṃ a sa ha ha na khrom 'di dbang du bsdus shig ces pa'o/ ༈ /yang ko ba mi 'bub pa la byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi g.yo bar bskyed/ chu phar khar yang mi g.yo ba 'od dang bcas pa gcig bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang mi g.yo ba ye shes pa tha mi dad pa spyan drangs/ chu phar ka'i mi g.yo ba la bstim/ mchod pa phul/ spyir ko ba mi bying ba dang*/ khyad par chu 'di la 'gro ba la ko ba mi 'bub par gsol ba btab/ des ko ba 'bub mi srid do/ ༈ /lcags sgrogs gis bcings pa 'grol na maṇ+ḍal phul/ de'i dbus su byi'u nas zan gyi brun spungs/ de la sngags stong phrag brgya bzlas lcags sgrog la bsdus pas lcags sgrog chad nas grol yong gsungs zab/ ༈ /yang gzhan gyi yid 'gugs pa'i thabs ni/ 'gugs sngags gser gyi lcags kyu ni/

pho la byed na mgron bu/ mo la byed na shing tshwa la/ oṃ maṅga ā yur puṇ+yai a dzī dha ra ye swā hā/ skyes pho mo'i bla khug ces skyes par rgyag na rkang rjes kyis/ mo la rgyag na mo rang gi gos kyi thom bu la rgyag rgyag pa'i dus ni pho la tshes gcig mo la gnam gang nyin/ ༈ /glo zhi ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ ra ta nan pa ra nan pa ra ni nan swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas zab/ ༈ /rmi lam gsal ba la/ oṃ tsan+t+ra de ba su phu ra li ye swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas na rmi lam gsal lo// yang rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i sngags ni/ na maḥsarba bud+dhā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nān na mo ha ta oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di lan gcig bzlas pas rmi lam can pa bzlog par 'gyur ro// lan gsum brjod pas dus min par 'chi ba bzlog par 'gyur ro// lan bzhi brjod pas bgegs pho mo thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// lan lnga brjod pas nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// lan drug brjod pas nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// lan gsum brjod pas nyungs kar la bzlas nas phur kha ston pa'i phyogs su 'phang na phur khas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// phra men phyin ci log gi rigs thams cad zlog ces bya ba zab/ ༈ /sho rgyan thob par 'dod na/ na mo bha ga te dzñā na ni sa hūm̐/ zhes pa mang du bzlas la nyungs kar la btab ras gtsang ma'i khug tshang cig gi nang du sngags btab pa'i nyungs kar dang zangs kyi byang bu mig dgu pa gcig mgron bu bu che ma/ g.yu rnying gcig ste de bzhi bcug nas lag pa g.yas la btags nas gril bas thob bo zab/ ༈ /gza' srung ba ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥm tri a su ra swā hā/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes pa spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ smyug sbubs la dkris nas tshon skud sna lngas dkris mgul du btags na srung ba'i mchog go /ra pa la brgyud pa'o/

༈ /yang gcig la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer can gyi rgyal po dri ma med pa zla ba'i sgron ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes mang du bzlas na gza'i nad mi 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /yang rlung gnon par 'dod pas/ rde'u dkar nag lnga la sngags 'di btab/ oṃ maṃ baṃ baṃ yu mu na tha ra 'byung ba'i kha chings/ zhes pa mang du btab/ phyogs su gtor bas bzlog nges/ ༈ /yang sad bsrung ba la/ lcam pa'i 'bru/ spyi ba'i 'bru/ skyer pa'i 'bru/ shug pa'i 'bru/ spra tshil/ spos dkar/ bdud rtsi ser po/ dom mkhris/ du ba ral pa/ stag sha/ spyang ki'i brun/ rgod tshil/ khyi lce ba/ phag khrag gong ma'i rdzas kyis srod la du ba btang*/ de 'og rdzas kyis nam phyed du ba btang*/ de 'og rdzas kyis tho rangs du ba btang*/ de 'og kun gyi bud shing yo mos byed de du ba gang dgos btang*/ gsum ka'i rdzas kyi bungs skyed/ gang bsrung yul du du ba'i ngad 'byung ba tsam gyis nges par thub po zab/ ༈ /grib srung ni/ a ha ba ta song la/ ya gi shi dza wa ra gā bhi sa ma 'bru ti bi man se u tsu ma kro tsi da kha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan bdun chu la bzlas nas 'thung na mi des yul khams brgyar myul yang mdze pho dme pho mi gtsang ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs/ 'di 'chang ba'i mi de shel dkar dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /yang lcags sreg 'dag pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ma ma da khye mu na ye swā hā/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas nyer gcig bzlas nas lcags bsreg ldag ༈ /za yig gi gdams pa ni/ na mo phud phud rak+ṣa phud phud sha phud phud tsa kri na swā hā/ za yig 'di rgya snag gis rgya shog la bris/ rang sngags kyis rab gnas byas la mjug nas yar dril te zos pas nag po dgu thub yin/ 'di bri dus dam tshig spyi dang mthun la/ khyad par gyi dam tshig ni bong bu'i skad mi thos pa byed zab rgya rgya/ rat+na gling pas gnam skas brag nas gdan drangs pa'o/
